rules.rule: Review Frappe v16 DocType schema, field types, required fields, role permissions, and database uniqueness constraints. Check consistency with Python validation and migrations; do not assume a UI-only duplicate check is race-safe.

Review server-side permission boundaries, DocType lifecycle validation, duplicate prevention under concurrency, and correctness on Frappe v16.50. Flag unsafe assumptions about client-side validation or database uniqueness.
Review employee/date/type validation and edge cases including malformed dates, missing employees, unsupported assignment types, and normalization. Verify consistency with the DocType.
Review integration tests for installation, migration, permissions, duplicate creation, and updates on Frappe v16.50; distinguish tested from untested claims.
Review pure Python tests for negative cases and realistic business invariants; do not mistake these for Frappe integration tests.
Review CI pinning, least privilege, reproducible Frappe v16.50 integration, test isolation, secrets, and whether successful jobs support the stated claims.
Review packaging, dependency constraints, and whether installed wheel and sdist contain required Frappe DocType resources.
Review app metadata and Frappe hook compatibility without assuming untested runtime behavior.
